name: Irisu Masataka
source:
Makina's father, the son-in-law and also the adopted son of Irisu house. He had a mild personality and strong sense of justice. [spoiler] 8 years ago, he died in an accident, or rather, was assassinated. He used to be an accountant of Ministry of Defense Management Division.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://vnsharing.net/forum/showthread.php?t=302644/]Shiori-chan's review[/url].]
